notes: The challenge repository says datasets are distributed under their original source terms.
The repository maintainer has confirmed use for this exact development test cohort after reviewing its terms.
The 2023 development test set is a 3,236,752,796-byte archive; Track 2 contains 600 test recordings, separate enrollment audio, and the official transcript TSV.
No paired clean waveform reference is provided for these recordings. Use non-intrusive quality measures and word accuracy as a separately identified track.
Publish aggregate scores and attribution only. Keep source audio out of Git, Pages, and workflow artifacts.
